card.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
card.a: No. You can start a 14-day free trial without a card. We only charge if you decide to keep using MyJova.

noEmail.q: What if my workers don't have email?
noEmail.a: In the current version, each worker needs an email to receive their portal invitation. We're adding PIN-based access for shared kiosks in a future release.

states.q: Which states are supported for tax withholding?
states.a: Federal US withholding (IRS Pub 15-T 2026) is fully supported. State withholding is currently zero for all states — we're rolling out state-by-state, prioritizing CA, NY, TX, FL, IL.

filing.q: Does MyJova file taxes for me?
filing.a: MyJova generates the W-2 and 1099-NEC PDFs. The official filing with IRS / SSA is still manual today. Direct e-filing integration is on our 2026 roadmap.

secure.a: Yes. We use Supabase with Row Level Security at the database, encrypted at rest, and strict multi-tenancy isolation. No company can see another's data.

cancel.a: Yes. No contracts, no minimum commitment. Cancel from the billing page in one click.

company.intro: From zero to your first payroll in seven steps.

s1.d: Settings → General: timezone, unpaid lunch policy (e.g. 30 min once a shift reaches 6 h) and whether you pay contractors.

s2.d: Address + geofence radius. Clock-ins outside the area get flagged for your review.

s3.d: Employees with their pay scheme (hourly, daily, salary, commission or piece-rate) and invite them by email — or pair a tablet as a PIN kiosk.

s4.d: Every shift comes with photo + GPS. Review hours in Time tracking and approve entries — or whole weeks when workers close them.

s5.d: Pick the period and employees. The engine computes overtime, taxes and net pay; approve and mark it paid.

s6.d: Everyone downloads their own stub; W-2 and 1099-NEC generate at year end.

s7.d: Turn the module on, set per-worker bill rates, and each payroll produces one consolidated check per top contractor with HST and a full breakdown. Invite them to their portal.

worker.intro: Everything you do fits in your phone.

s1.d: You get an email — create your password and sign in from your phone.

s2.d: One big button: selfie + location. On sites with a tablet, type your PIN at the kiosk.

s3.d: If you skipped your lunch break, check 'I did not take my lunch' so your full time is paid.

s4.d: Fix a forgotten clock-out right from the clock screen, or report the full shift under 'Hours'. Your manager approves it.

s5.d: The 'Hours' tab shows your week day by day with each entry's status.

s6.d: When your week is done, tap 'Close week & request pay'. Your manager approves it and it goes into payroll.

s7.d: Under 'Pay' you'll find every stub with the full detail, ready to download as PDF.

contractor.intro: Your portal shows only your crew and your money.

s1.d: Your login gets linked to your contractor company.

s2.d: Your workers, what you pay them, what you bill the company and your margin per hour — plus this week’s hours.

s3.t: Your crew clocks with the company
s3.d: You don’t run payroll: the company approves hours and pays. You watch it all from your portal.

s4.d: For each payroll: billed subtotal, HST, your check total, what you pay your crew and your margin — with a PDF for your books.

s5.d: Your workers only ever see THEIR rate. What you bill the company stays between you and the company.
